paper_id: Chen et al. - 2009 - BloomCast Efficient Full-Text Retrieval over Unstructured P2Ps with Guaranteed Recall
title: BloomCast: Efficient Full-Text Retrieval over Unstructured P2Ps with Guaranteed Recall
motivation: Unstructured P2P无法保证召回率,全量复制文档通信/存储开销不可接受
problem_framing: 把副本和查询建模为球与桶模型,寻找使碰撞概率最大化的最优副本数
key_insight: 用Bloom Filter替代原始文档复制,可将通信/存储成本大幅降低同时保证完美召回率
method_signature: Balls-and-Bins约束下求最優副本数r=g=c*sqrt(N),用Bloom Filter实现集合成员验证
evaluation_criteria: 召回率、通信开销、复制成本、搜索效率(Recall/Communication Cost)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Bloom Filter的假阳性会导致轻微精确率下降
evidence_for_taste: The root cause is that DHTs are based on exact hashing schemes, providing poor full-text search capacity
The minimal cost can be achieved when r=c*sqrt(N*q/d)
Due to the false positives of Bloom Filters, the returned results may contain undesired documents
It is difficult to guarantee that the keyword set that users are interested in are exactly the keyword set selected for indexes
thinking_moves: 把查询-文档匹配问题形式化为Balls-and-Bins碰撞概率问题
用约束优化求最优副本数,得到通信成本O(sqrt(N))的正式界
用Bloom Filter的成员验证能力解决全文本检索而不复制原始文档
承认Bloom Filter假阳性会牺牲精确率换取召回率
